CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red cells), an explicit organization/presentation pattern and a separate origin/status field are all present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to content presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: The text names explicit represented contents (color-labeled cell sets) with coordinates.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are reported separately from content coordinates, distinguishing identity from status/source.

O.rationale: The report explicitly states how content is organized/presented (grid orientation and coordinate listings).
